ios.desc:
How does chai work?
- Talk about something on your mind by creating conversations in the home tab
- Join someone's conversation by swiping right in the explore tab and responding
- View all your current conversations in the messaging tab

All conversations are reset every 24 hours so that you can talk to a different person each day.
Learn more about how chai works and see it in action at https://chaitheapp.com

quotes.text:
Hi I made an app over the past few months called Chai

Iphone Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chai/id1530962229

Android Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.chaitheapp

also here's a very outdated demo of it: https://www.chaitheapp.com/

I don't have a lot of people to share it with so I thought I'd share it here. I would love to get any feedback you guys can give me.

Also here's why I made it and think it can help (at least for me) improve mental health:
I've found that whenever my mental health is at its worst its because I feel lonely. This is especially true right now because the pandemic has ended up isolating a lot of people. I know in my own personal life I graduated from school and moved for a job and had to leave a lot of friends behind. This would be easier to deal with if we weren't stuck in a pandemic but right now it's really hard to make friends.

Anyway the point of the app is to always have someone to talk to. You can create a conversation about almost anything and then feel more connected with people because you are talking to someone. The point isn't to use it as a replacement for friends in real life but more of a pick me up when you are feeling down. Hope you will try it out! Thanks
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Chai – an app to improve your mental health through conversation
